ticker_news.title: 2 High-Flying AI Stocks I'd Sell Before 2026 Arrives
ticker_news.description: The article recommends selling two AI stocks, Palantir and BigBear.ai, due to unrealistic valuations and poor growth prospects heading into 2026.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury

ticker_news.title: Jefferies Sees $198 Billion Revenue Potential By 2040 For Quantum Computing
ticker_news.description: Jefferies analysts predict quantum computing industry could grow from $1 billion to $198 billion by 2040, with major tech companies and governments supporting the emerging technology.
ticker_news.author: Namrata Sen

ticker_news.title: Nvidia Vs. Alphabet: Which Could Be The World's Biggest Company By End-2026?
ticker_news.description: Nvidia and Alphabet are competing to become the world's largest company by end-2026, with both having a 35% probability of achieving this milestone. Their competition centers around AI dominance, with Nvidia leading in GPU technology and Alphabet embedding AI across its product ecosystem.
ticker_news.author: Piero Cingari

ticker_news.title: Should You Buy Rivian While It's Below $20?
ticker_news.description: Rivian is exploring AI and autonomous vehicle technologies, planning a semi-autonomous subscription service and a more affordable R2 vehicle by 2026, but faces challenges in the competitive EV market with uncertain near-term growth prospects.
ticker_news.author: Chris Neiger
